items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the indoor fitting fractured by frost. Allow €52 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that must be renewed with the fractured fitting. Allow €27 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary fitting repair labour. Three hours at approximately €100 gross per hour give a line estimate of €299.

Sections 3.6(c) and 7.1.7(e) distinguish contractor equipment from consumables actually used in the covered repair. This generic line was not paid in the matching cases; allow €6 gross only if qualifying materials are substantiated.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one necessary attendance, and no repeat visit is billed. The two closest same-wording cases support €40 gross.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to locate the escape, and the claim explains why it was needed. Allow €17.60 gross, below the €2,500 aggregate leak-location limit.

items.description: Facade damage from frozen escaped water
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render damaged when water from the internal burst froze in the wall; optional external frost cover is not needed. Allow €120 gross if this line represents distinct repair work rather than a heading or a duplicate of the itemised work.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of failed render on the affected patch. Allow €155 gross for one removal item, benchmarked against the two-item removal in Case 32.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the area damaged by the escape. Allow €38 gross for the line.

Section 9.6 requires the work to be identifiable and allocable to the insured damage; this description does not establish either. Allow €45 gross only if distinct, necessary repair work is documented.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers re-forming the substrate on the affected patch. Allow €31 gross for the line.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(d) cover paint on the damaged area in the number of coats the like-for-like finish system requires. Allow €59 gross for the line, with no allowance for repainting unaffected areas.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary drying before reinstatement of the saturated wall. Allow €254 gross for drying the affected area.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers necessary preparation and finish materials for the reinstated render. Allow €117 gross for priming the affected patch.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers labour on the affected area. Five hours at approximately €55 gross per hour give a line estimate of €277.
Sections 3.6(b), 7.1.12 and 9.6 exclude administrative add-ons and require a lump sum to price identifiable covered work. Allow €15 gross only if the charge is shown to be for distinct covered work.
